pages.yml/action.why: The overflow switch: the runner job's label, ubuntu-latest unless CI_OVERFLOW_RUNNER names a lane in .github/ci-overflow.json and tools/ci_overflow.py reads it under its stop (the owner, 2026-11-04; templates/ci/DECISIONS.md, 2026-11-10)

ci-standard.yml/standard.why: The overflow switch for every caller: the runner input, from ci-overflow.yml's label, when it is a lane label in .github/ci-overflow.json, else ubuntu-latest (templates/ci/DECISIONS.md, 2026-11-11)
